beats.headline: About DentaSource Direct
beats.body: We supply dental chairs, imaging and endodontic equipment to clinics across the Philippines, and we install what we sell.

beats.headline: One channel, from the source to your operatory
beats.body: Exclusive Philippine distributor for ROSON and for Denjoy, with the largest dental showroom in the country and a training center minutes from it. Everything we sell is uncrated and tested here before it goes out, and our own technicians assemble it in the room where it will be used.

beats.headline: The largest dental showroom in the country
beats.body: 610 C. Raymundo Avenue, Maybunga, Pasig City. Open Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM. Compare models side by side in the same light, sit in them, and bring your operatory measurements.

beats.headline: Two exclusive lines, held in one place
beats.body: ROSON chairs reach Filipino clinics through one channel, straight from the source, so the unit on our floor is the unit ROSON shipped. Denjoy joined it in June 2026: endo motors, apex locators, ultrasonic activators and the workstations that hold them, with the spares and the support kept here.

beats.headline: A room of phantom heads, minutes away
beats.body: Units 307 and 308, 3rd Floor, Mercedes Square Plaza, Mercedes Avenue corner Luis Street, San Miguel, Pasig City. A row of simulator stations, an interactive teaching board, and courses run with partner study groups.

beats.headline: Come and sit in the chair
beats.body: 610 C. Raymundo Avenue, Maybunga, Pasig City, Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM. No appointment needed, though telling us you are coming means the model you want is set up and powered when you arrive.
